instruction: Look at hard-14_seed.dxf. For the steps below, launch AutoCAD 2024 from the desktop shortcut, then open `hard-14_seed.dxf`. Create the hard AutoCAD drawing 'pump volute and foot casting layout' using exact model-space coordinates in millimeters. Create or keep these layers exactly as needed: ANNOTATION, CENTER, CUTOUT, HOLE, OUTLINE, REFERENCE, RIB. Straight geometry may be LINE entities or straight LWPOLYLINE edges; every listed rounded or slot end must be an ARC entity using the listed start/end angles in degrees. Required straight segments: OUTLINE (135,70)->(230,70); OUTLINE (230,70)->(230,110); OUTLINE (230,110)->(135,110); OUTLINE (135,110)->(135,70); OUTLINE (35,0)->(145,0); OUTLINE (145,0)->(145,28); OUTLINE (145,28)->(35,28); OUTLINE (35,28)->(35,0); CENTER (90,0)->(90,152); CENTER (28,90)->(230,90); RIB (135,70)->(145,28); RIB (135,110)->(145,28). Required circles: OUTLINE center (90,90) radius 62; CUTOUT center (90,90) radius 28; HOLE center (55,14) radius 5; HOLE center (125,14) radius 5; HOLE center (165,90) radius 6; HOLE center (210,90) radius 6. Required arcs: OUTLINE center (105,95) radius 74 start 310 end 75; RIB center (90,90) radius 45 start 15 end 65; RIB center (90,90) radius 45 start 145 end 205; RIB center (90,90) radius 45 start 250 end 300. Required text strings: ANNOTATION text ACAD-H14; ANNOTATION text VOLUTE-A. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder.
